nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): The WooCommerce owner retrieves the complete period population with `woo_orders_list(page=1, perPage=100, dateAfter=<inclusive period start ISO>, dateBefore=<inclusive period end ISO>)`, omitting `status` so every observed status is retained. Continue with increasing literal `page` and the same camelCase `perPage`/date bounds until the returned pagination or a short/empty terminal page proves exhaustion. Preserve deterministic page order and explicit page/count/value controls. Persist one runtime-unique normalized JSON artifact with order/transaction key, timestamps, gross/net amounts, refunds or adjustments only where actually exposed, currency, merchant/account fields, and source status. Read it back and return only path/hash, endpoint/page ledger, count, amount totals, status totals, and null/duplicate controls.

explore 1 (enterprise-data-analyst 1): The Snowflake owner discovers the authoritative warehouse transaction and accounting sources, then uses deterministic bounded queries to retrieve the complete same-period rows and independent aggregate controls. Preserve revenue, COGS, operating expenses, adjustments, dates, keys, and accounts only when present. Persist one runtime-unique JSON artifact, read it back, and return only path/hash, table/column mapping, query bounds, counts/value totals, and null/duplicate controls.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): The sole spreadsheet writer creates `Financial_Audit.xlsx` in the resolved workspace with substantive `Audit Summary`, `Reconciliation`, `Exceptions`, `Variance Analysis`, and `Supporting Schedules` sheets. Pass counts, monetary totals, variances, and percentages to Excel as JSON numbers rather than formatted strings; keep labels and unavailable values textual. Include period/method/tolerance and at least one visual summary. Read every populated range back, require nonzero `int`/`float` cells adjacent to reconciliation/count/total/amount/rate labels, and reconcile those typed values to the canonical controls before returning.

coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): The sole document writer creates `Financial_Audit_Report.docx` with executive summary, scope/method, source totals, every exception class, root causes, recommendations, action plan, supporting schedules, and explicit unavailable-data notes. Read the complete document back and reconcile all repeated totals.
